messages:
elaine-sec: FYI we flagged an exposure: a private CI cache used for wheel builds included an API token for our internal pip mirror. Token appeared in cached .whl metadata and was unintentionally uploaded to a third-party cache CDN. Immediate actions required: rotate mirror token, purge caches, rebuild affected artifacts.

tom-ci: How was this token stored? environment secret in GH Actions?

elaine-sec: Token was inserted into a temporary env var by a helper script in ci/scripts/publish_wheel.sh then inadvertently cached by our fast-cache step. The cache key included ${{ hashFiles('**/dist/*.whl') }} so the artifact and metadata persisted in the cache snapshot.

ravi-infra: Do we have a quick way to list affected caches and where the cached blobs landed?

elaine-sec: Automated scan found references across 8 repos and 3 ephemeral runners. remediation-bot pushed a report: https://internal.redwood/ci-exposure/1750012345. Summary: 8 cached bundles, 5 third-party CDN edge caches, 2 private mirror uploads that used the token.

remediation-bot: Scan output: repos: infra-sdks, python-runtime, model-bundles, examples, data-sync, ingestion, deploy-scripts, edge-builds. Suspect artifacts: *.whl with METADATA entry starting with X-Internal-Token:. See report link above for file list.

tom-ci: Immediate mitigation steps I'll kick off:
1) Revoke the exposed mirror token (rotated now).
2) Create replacement token scoped to read-only mirror and limited to CI service account.
3) Invalidate CDN cache where possible (will open purge requests).

jen-legal: Do we need to notify any customers or partners? Any PII exposures?

elaine-sec: No PII detected. The token allowed read/write to our private mirror but not wider customer data. Legal, we will run the data access audit and share a short memo. If anything changes we'll escalate.

ravi-infra: Commands and checks for teams:
- Search repos for token pattern: `git grep -n \"X-Internal-Token\" || grep -R \"X-Internal-Token\" .`
- Find cached artifacts in our cache service:
  - `curl -sS https://cache.internal.redwood/list?prefix=ci-cache | jq .`
- Invalidate CDN edges (example): `cdnctl purge --resource edge-cdn-id --paths \"/cache/<blob>\"`
- For GCS-based caches: `gsutil ls gs://ci-cache-bucket/** | grep .whl` then `gsutil rm gs://ci-cache-bucket/path/to/blob`

ravi-infra: Also run this in your repo root to find whl metadata with the token:
```
python -c "import zipfile,sys
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
  if f.endswith('.whl'):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(f) as z:
      try:
        md=z.read('METADATA').decode()
        if 'X-Internal-Token:' in md:
          print(f)
      except KeyError:
        pass
" $(find . -name \"*.whl\")
```

tom-ci: We're updating the GH Actions workflow to avoid caching build artifacts that include secrets. New step: scrub METADATA before caching and use separate cache keys for build outputs vs dependencies. I'll push the workflow patch and tag repos; target deploy in 6h.

remediation-bot: Auto-check: 5 of 8 repos already removed cached blobs via API. 3 remain pending due to CDN TTLs. See live status: https://internal.redwood/ci-exposure/1750012345/status

elaine-sec: Required owner actions (deadline 48h):
- Rotate any tokens listed in the report. Provide rotation ticket link in the report.
- Purge caches and confirm removal in the scan status page.
- Rebuild and re-publish artifacts from a clean environment. Do not reuse caches.

ravi-infra: Add-on best practices: use short-lived tokens (OIDC-based) for CI -> mirror authentication, and never embed tokens in artifact metadata. We'll provide a helper lib to inject ephemeral creds at upload time.

jen-legal: Please add a brief note in the internal incident log describing scope, actions, and that customers were not affected. We may reuse for compliance audit.

tom-ci: Question: do we need to rotate tokens used by private customer deploys' sync jobs? They use the same mirror token today.

elaine-sec: If a private deploy uses the same token, rotate immediately and coordinate with account-ops. For any customer-facing deploys we will treat as high priority and will block publishes until new token is in place. Escalate via sec-oncall if you hit permission issues.

remediation-bot: Reminder: submit remediation tickets with label `ci-cache-exposure` and include the report link. Auto-created ticket template available at https://issues.redwood/security/ci-cache-template.

ravi-infra: I'll publish a short cookbook for rebuilding wheels and forcing fresh builds in GH Actions: avoid `actions/cache` for wheel artifacts; instead upload to secure artifact store and expire in 24h.

elaine-sec: We'll run a follow-up sweep in 72h to ensure all affected artifacts are rebuilt and no stale tokens remain. If any team can't meet the timeline, open an exemption with justification.

jen-legal: Thanks team. Please CC me on the rotation tickets for recordkeeping.

tom-ci: Pushing the workflow patches now. Will post PR links here when ready.

elaine-sec: Appreciate the quick response. We'll close the critical alert once rebuilds and purges are confirmed. :lock:
